slides.title: The problem
bullets: Identity questions stall cases, hires and investigations
Manual searching across 1,000+ sites is slow and inconsistent
Ad-hoc screenshots are not defensible evidence
slides.notes: Open with the buyer's pain: time, consistency, defensibility.

slides.title: What you receive
bullets: A PDF Digital Footprint Report per identifier (username, handle, e-mail pattern)
Detected profiles with confidence bands (High / Medium / Low)
Inconclusive & unreachable sites listed — nothing hidden
Method, limitations and lawful-use statement on every report
slides.notes: Show the sample report. Emphasise transparency: failed checks are reported, not dropped.

slides.title: How it works
left: 1. Engagement opened with stated lawful purpose
slides.notes: Every step is recorded. Approval gates are human, not automated.

slides.title: What it is not
bullets: Not a consumer report (FCRA) — no adverse-action use without your own legal basis
No account access, no private data, no scraping behind logins
Confidence ≠ identity: medium/low bands require corroboration
slides.notes: Set expectations early; it protects both sides.
